data.content_ref: inline:Per-root commit certificates: without altering the fixpoint, change what a commit carries. Each accepted (IN) node gets a compact certificate — the minimal grounded subframework witnessing its IN status in Pass 1 — so a root's validity is checkable by replaying only O(|witness|) nodes rather than the whole framework. All four guarantees are untouched (the operator is unchanged), but 'validity of every committed root' becomes a local, per-root proof rather than a global invariant. This complements SRC_003's fragility profile (single-edge deletion analysis) with a constructive witness, and makes commits independently auditable by a third party holding only the certificate.
